request.question: Which titles have the highest list price but the fewest units sold? Those are the ones that make money as picks, right?

reply: The terminal has no list price, so I can't rank titles by it. It also has no cost, margin or profit data, and whether those titles make money as picks is not my shelf. I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value by title.
